title: Stalk of a tensor product of modules, and germs of tensor products of sections
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ $\mathcal O_X$-modules, with tensor product $\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] (the sheafification of $U\mapsto\mathcal F(U)\otimes_{\mathcal O_X(U)}\mathcal G(U)$); for an open $U$ and $s\in\mathcal F(U)$, $t\in\mathcal G(U)$ write $s\otimes t\in(\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G)(U)$ for the image of $s\otimes t$ under the sheafification map. Then for every $x\in X$ there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules
$$(\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G)_x\;\cong\;\mathcal F_x\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}}\mathcal G_x,$$
natural in $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal G$, under which the germ $(s\otimes t)_x$ (for $x\in U$) corresponds to $s_x\otimes t_x$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 17.16.1 (Tag 01CB, label lemma-stalk-tensor-product; proof omitted in the source: stalks are colimits over neighbourhoods, sheafification does not change stalks, and tensor products commute with filtered colimits); compare Sheaves, Lemma Tag 008B (lemma-stalk-tensor-sheaf-modules) for the change-of-rings case

lean.statement: theorem stalkTensorIso (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.{u}) (x : X) : let R := (sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf letI := monoidalCategory X.sheaf let S := AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x ∃ Φ : ∀ F G : SheafOfModules.{u} R, S.obj (F ⊗ G) ≅ S.obj F ⊗ S.obj G, (∀ (F G : SheafOfModules.{u} R) (U : Opens X) (hx : x ∈ U) (s : F.val.obj (op U)) (t : G.val.obj (op U)), let P := F.val ⊗ G.val let θ := (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 R.obj)).unit.app P ≫ (forget R).map (tensorObjIsoSheafification F G).inv (Φ F G).hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (F ⊗ G).val.presheaf U x hx ((θ.app (op U)) (s ⊗ₜ[X.presheaf.obj (op U)] t))) = (TopCat.Presheaf.germ F.val.presheaf U x hx s) ⊗ₜ[X.presheaf.stalk x] (TopCat.Presheaf.germ G.val.presheaf U x hx t)) ∧ (∀ (F G F' G' : SheafOfModules.{u} R) (f : F ⟶ F') (g : G ⟶ G'), S.map (f ⊗ₘ g) ≫ (Φ F' G').hom = (Φ F G).hom ≫ (S.map f ⊗ₘ S.map g))
lean.note: Apply SheafOfModules.stalkTensorIso X.toRingedSpace x. Its conclusion is exactly the scheme node, including the sheafification-unit germ formula and naturality in both module sheaves; no new hypothesis is needed. The duplicate scheme-specialized module was removed in the second reading.
